question: Please find out how widespread the appeal of our top five actors is. What percentage of our customers have rented films featuring these actors?
sql:
-- Final verification with explicit calculation
WITH top5_actors AS (
    SELECT a.actor_id
    FROM actor a
    JOIN film_actor fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id
    GROUP BY a.actor_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(fa.film_id) DESC, a.actor_id ASC
    LIMIT 5
),
top5_films AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT fa.film_id
    FROM film_actor fa
    WHERE fa.actor_id IN (SELECT actor_id FROM top5_actors)
),
customers_with_top5 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT r.customer_id
    FROM rental r
    JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    WHERE i.film_id IN (SELECT film_id FROM top5_films)
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT cw.customer_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id), 2) AS percentage
FROM customer c
LEFT JOIN customers_with_top5 cw ON c.customer_id = cw.customer_id;
